visual_diff_config_contract.rule: When adding visual checks, append entries to visual_diff_config.json that conform to the schema and preserve all existing entries.

global_pass_definition.summary: Visual pass means the implementation matches approved mockups in layout, spacing, typography, colors, proportions, component states, and behavior-relevant visual affordances.
must_not_do: Do not weaken thresholds to pass.
Do not delete old visual_diff_config.json entries.
Do not replace references without explicit mockup approval.
Do not rely only on numeric diff; inspect diff images and screenshots.

required_agent_steps: Use visual_diff_config.example.json as the template for new entries.
Write or update functional tests before implementation.
Create or update a project-local screenshot capture script for the feature.
Capture screenshots into visual-checks/current/ using visual_diff_config.json ids.
Append new visual_diff_config.json entries without deleting old ones.
Run the full visual_diff_config.json, not only the current feature.
Inspect screenshots and diff images manually.
Fix visual and functional regressions before declaring completion.

functional: Feature renders in the target UI state.
Failure or empty state is covered when relevant.
visual: Screenshot capture script exists or was updated.
Screenshot output path matches visual_diff_config.json test.img.
regression: Full visual diff suite is run before completion.

visual_pass_means: The screenshot viewport matches the reference mockup viewport.
Primary layout geometry matches.
Spacing, alignment, and component proportions match.
Colors and contrast match approved mockup intent.
Important states shown in the mockup are reproduced.
The visual diff passes thresholds and the diff image has no meaningful regressions.
required_tests: Functional test for the UI state represented by this mockup.
Screenshot capture for this feature id.
Visual diff entry in visual_diff_config.json.
Regression run of the full visual_diff_config.json.
